{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute number of converted loyal customers
num_converted = (loyal_df['converted'] == 1).sum()

# Compute total number of loyal customers
num_loyal = len(loyal_df)

# Compute conversion fraction
conversion_fraction = num_converted / num_loyal

# Print all required numbers
print(f'Number of loyal customers: {num_loyal}')
print(f'Number of converted loyal customers: {num_converted}')
print(f'Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}')"}
